name: mesero-ai-server-desktop
description: Builds the Mesero AI backend into a single executable for a restaurant PC or a reComputer

scripts.build:win: npm run bundle && pkg build/mesero-server.cjs --targets node20-win-x64 --output dist/win/mesero-server.exe
scripts.build:recomputer: npm run bundle && pkg build/mesero-server.cjs --targets node20-linux-arm64 --output dist/recomputer/mesero-server
scripts.build: npm run build:win && npm run build:recomputer
